thesisIdeas.title: Integration of Generative AI for NPCs
thesisIdeas.description: Investigate the integration of LLMs for NPCs in video games and advance the state of the art through the design of a prototype, experiment, or vision. Explores how LLM-powered NPCs can enable more complex characters, immersive experiences, and revolutionize video game testing.

thesisIdeas.title: Generative AI Agents for Real-Time Player Support in Video Games
thesisIdeas.description: Design and develop a prototype of a local Generative AI agent capable of interacting with a player's game in real time. The agent may provide different forms of support, enhancing player enjoyment, improving performance, and reducing player churn.

thesisIdeas.title: Git Gud—Adaptive Difficulty for Video Games
thesisIdeas.description: Explore and compare different approaches for implementing dynamic difficulty adjustment (DDA) mechanisms, leveraging AI and LLMs to continuously adapt game difficulty in real time, sustaining player flow and engagement.

thesisIdeas.title: AI-Powered Tools for Supporting Software Engineers Across the Software Lifecycle
thesisIdeas.description: Investigate the design, development, and evaluation of AI-powered tools that support software engineers across one or more phases of the SDLC, from requirements and design to testing, deployment, and maintenance.
